items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slips under $86,000 as money rotates into BCH and ZEC
items.summary: Bitcoin matched Monday's high near $87,300 before running into selling, while citcoin cash surged 28% on a CME futures listing and ZEC added 9%.

items.title: CFTC Staff Advisory Says Prediction Market 'Mention' Contracts Invite Manipulation
items.summary: Three weeks after fining a teleprompter operator who traded on speeches he had already read, regulators set out what exchanges must show.

items.title: CFTC chair pushes tokenization as SEC opens door to onchain stocks
items.summary: Michael Selig said tokenization could reshape financial markets as the CFTC and SEC continue advancing onchain initiatives despite the CLARITY Act setback.

items.title: Canada’s big six banks explore tokenized deposit system to modernize payments
items.summary: The banks said the first phase of the project involves moving tokenized deposits efficiently across financial institutions.
